title: Queuekeeper: local merge queue and build coordinator
author: vocaro
selftext:
Here's a tool I built to help manage the flood of changes being generated by my Claude Code and Codex agents: [https://github.com/vocaro/queuekeeper](https://github.com/vocaro/queuekeeper)

The agents kept finishing changes and trying to run tests all at the same time, each competing for my Mac, Unity, the Xcode simulators, the Android emulators, and my iPhone. To manage the chaos, I built a local merge queue and build farm. It groups changes into batches, tests the changes together, and pushes them to main only after they pass. It also spreads builds across my Macs so they don’t all pile up on one machine.

It's free and open source. If this sounds like your setup, give it a try and let me know how it goes.
